description: Design GitHub API integration for Git Control Tower: evaluate go-github library, define client interface for full mockability (all GitHub calls behind interface), auth strategy (GitHub PAT vs app token vs existing SSH key infrastructure — SSH handles git transport, API calls need token-based auth), mock testing architecture (interface-based DI, zero real GitHub API calls in tests), what PR metadata to surface, how review panel results can feed into PR descriptions. Token storage in existing credentials system.
name: gct-github-api-design
title: Design GitHub client interface, auth strategy, and mock testing architecture
